label: Act is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to POTENCY_2 at a first being, from Theta.8 incorruptibility
description: First-being act priority for the independent POTENCY_2 parameter from the six premises of the Theta.8 route: by firstBeingNoPotencyOfThetaEight a first being is in potency in no respect, so the first-being version holds vacuously. Registered per route, not through the sense-neutral untimed q.3 a.1 conclusion, so that the POTENCY_1 act-priority route to that conclusion (a4d3261a) does not reach the POTENCY_2 first-being version without a sense bridge. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
